bank.reflect_mission: You are helping a support agent remember its customers. Recall each customer's history, open and past issues, account context, and how they prefer to be treated, so every interaction feels informed and personal.
bank.retain_mission: Extract customer issues and their resolutions, sentiment, account and plan details, product context, promises and commitments made, and any preferences. Ignore greetings and pleasantries.
bank.observations_mission: Track stable facts per customer: their account and plan, recurring issues, product usage, preferences, and how their sentiment trends over time.

mental_models.name: Customer Profile
mental_models.source_query: Who is this customer? What is their account, plan, product usage, and how do they prefer to be supported?

mental_models.name: Issue & Resolution History
mental_models.source_query: What issues has this customer reported, and how were they resolved? What is still open or unresolved?

mental_models.name: Sentiment Overview
mental_models.source_query: What is the customer's overall sentiment and how has it trended across interactions? What frustrates or delights them?

directives.name: Never re-ask known details
directives.content: Use the customer's recalled account and history instead of asking them to repeat information they've already given. Re-asking known details erodes trust.

directives.name: Lead with empathy
directives.content: Acknowledge the customer's situation and sentiment before jumping to a solution, especially when the recalled history shows repeated or unresolved issues.
